name: istat_parental_education_by_region
title: ISTAT Parental Education Attainment by Region (Intergenerational)
why_needed: Direct parental education attainment distribution by region is needed for the OED/Goldthorpe mobility analysis (origin dimension). ISTAT's RCFL survey and census data track this. Enables direct computation of intergenerational educational transmission rates by territory.
api_status: blocked — ISTAT SDMX catalogue search did not surface a RCFL/parental-education-by-region flow with the keywords tested. ISTAT esploradati timeout/500 errors persist for some flows.
manual_steps: 1. Go to https://esploradati.istat.it/ → search 'titolo di studio genitore'
2. Or use https://www.istat.it/it/archivio/istruzione → 'Indagine sulle forze di lavoro' → download by educational attainment + parent
3. Alternative: ISTAT BES dataset 'Istruzione' includes parental background indicators at regional level.
